title: 36 Hours in Edinburgh
abstract: Fall is the ideal time to explore the ruggedly beautiful Scottish capital, which turns 900 this year.

title: 36 Hours in the Berkshires
abstract: Take a road trip across this mountainous region of western Massachusetts, popping into breweries, art galleries and pizzerias, as its landscape erupts in autumnal glory.

title: 36 Hours in Hanoi, Vietnam
abstract: Get swept up in the boundless energy of the 1,000-year-old Vietnamese capital.

title: 36 Hours in Moab, Utah
abstract: Walk among sandstone towers, experience some of the darkest skies in North America and breathe in the solitude.

title: 36 Hours in Lyon, France
abstract: Dine in rustic restaurants, ride a funicular for panoramic views and hunt for treasures at a sprawling flea market in France’s third-largest city.
